description: Registrar-General Department - Registration of Death (temporary provision) will be extended by another two years from 09th of December, 2019 to 09th  December, 2021
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the extension of a legal regulation under the Registration of Deaths (Temporary Provision) Act, No. 19 of 2010. It involves a regulatory matter (extending the effective period of operation of an existing act) and is published as a government notification of a legal instrument. While a minister is named, the primary content is regulatory/legal in nature, not about government personnel or structure, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
